nl: Enable the setting `maxmemory 256mb` in redis.conf by removing the comment marker from its line. Other commented lines stay commented.
oracle_program: lines "redis.conf" |> filter text == "# maxmemory 256mb" |> replace "# maxmemory 256mb" "maxmemory 256mb" mode: literal
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('redis.conf')
t = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = '# maxmemory 256mb\n'
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_bytes(t.replace(old, 'maxmemory 256mb\n').encode('utf-8'))
EOF
